boundaries.structural_observation: 18 hydrophobic atom pairs are classified in the reference state combination.
boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: Each pair contributes a known favourable binding enthalpy.
boundaries.reason: Interaction classification is geometric and template-conditioned; no pair energy, desolvation, entropy, or ensemble average is available.

boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: The ring pair contributes a known ring-stacking free energy.
boundaries.reason: Robustness across the tested cutoffs does not supply an energy or a population.

boundaries.structural_observation: 2 ligand-donor candidates satisfy the tested D-H...A criteria.
boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: These candidates contribute a known hydrogen-bond free energy.
boundaries.reason: Hydrogen positions are generated, protein-donor hydrogens are unavailable, and geometric criteria are not energies.

boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: The water-mediated interaction has a known free-energy contribution.
boundaries.reason: Water orientation and roles are unassigned, crystallographic occupancy is not an equilibrium probability, and no displacement free energy is available.

boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: A combination with more classified interactions binds more strongly.
boundaries.reason: Counts are not additive energies, and chemical-state hypotheses are not equilibrium populations.

boundaries.structural_observation: The deposited crystal structure supplies one structural observation.
boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: The crystal structure defines the equilibrium Boltzmann population.
boundaries.reason: A crystal structure is a structural observation; no ensemble or partition function is available.

boundaries.structural_observation: Robustness conclusions: 4 invariant, 8 assumption-sensitive, 3 unsupported, 2 unknown.
boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: Invariant classifications are experimentally validated or physically certain.
boundaries.reason: Invariance is only with respect to the tested assumption range; it is not an energy or an experimental validation.

boundaries.structural_observation: 8 ligand states and 2 protein states are enumerated.
boundaries.thermodynamic_claim: Their relative populations or free energies are known.
boundaries.reason: No pKa/population model or state free energies are supplied.

terms.name: Interaction enthalpy
terms.detail: Requires a force field and an ensemble average of ligand-protein interaction energies in the bound state.

terms.name: Desolvation
terms.detail: Requires solvation free energies for the ligand, protein, and complex, including polar and nonpolar contributions.

terms.name: Ligand conformational entropy
terms.detail: Requires conformational sampling of the free and bound ligand and an entropy estimator.

terms.name: Protein conformational entropy
terms.detail: Requires sampling of protein side chains, loops, and possible conformational changes.

terms.name: Water reorganisation
terms.detail: Requires water roles, residence behaviour, and the free-energy cost of displacing or reorganising waters.

terms.name: Translational and rotational entropy
terms.detail: Requires a defined standard state and a free-energy method that treats the loss of translational and rotational freedom.

terms.name: Protonation and tautomer populations
terms.detail: The state hypotheses are enumerated, but no state free energies or populations are available.

terms.name: Conformational strain
terms.detail: Requires a force field and a bound-versus-free strain energy calculation.

requirements.name: Defensible molecular model
requirements.detail: Deposited heavy atoms and explicit chemical-state hypotheses are available; no force-field-ready model is defined.

requirements.name: Protein preparation
requirements.detail: Pocket atoms and residue-template chemistry are available; protein hydrogens, protonation populations, and force-field parameters are not.

requirements.name: Ligand preparation
requirements.detail: The ligand graph and generated hydrogens are available; force-field charges, parameters, and a validated protonation population are not.

requirements.name: Water and ion preparation
requirements.detail: Deposited waters are preserved with unassigned roles; no equilibrated water or ion environment has been prepared.

requirements.name: Force-field parameters
requirements.detail: No ligand, protein, water, or ion force-field parameter set has been assigned or validated.

requirements.name: Conformational sampling
requirements.detail: No MD, Monte Carlo, or alchemical sampling has been performed for this complex.

requirements.name: Defined thermodynamic states
requirements.detail: Ligand and protein chemical-state hypotheses exist, but the bound/free endpoints and any alchemical path are not defined.

requirements.name: Standard state and temperature
requirements.detail: No standard-state concentration or temperature convention has been fixed for a binding free-energy calculation.

requirements.name: Convergence and uncertainty
requirements.detail: No free-energy estimate, replicate analysis, or uncertainty propagation is available.

requirements.name: Experimental affinity validation
requirements.detail: No matched assay and affinity record is part of this capstone record.
